question.instructions: Are these two C programs semantically equivalent? Here equivalent means: when run on the same input, the two programs always have the same program state at every corresponding point reachable by program execution.

criteria.true: Yes: the two programs are equivalent in the sense defined above.
criteria.false: No: there is at least one (valid) input on which they differ in the sense defined above.
